resources.string: Your BMI (Body Mass Index) is a measure that uses your height and weight to work out if your weight is healthy.
Your BMI indicates you are in the healthy weight range for your height. Maintaining a balanced diet and regular physical activity is key to long-term vitality.

• Continue balanced diet (vegetables, fruits, protein)
 • Exercise regularly (at least 3-5 times a week)
 • Stay hydrated
 • Maintain consistent sleep schedule
